flags.message: All three candidates report that at their 2026-10-03 run the provisioned application (44 pages, fetched 2026-10-03) carried empty_text: true and a blank application.txt, so every prediction was made from the docket line and caption alone. The record staged for this evaluation now carries an OCR-derived body (documents.json: empty_text false, ocr_derived true) showing a Texas child-custody conservatorship modification and writ of attachment, with the appeal dismissed below for nonpayment of a $205 fee. Not a defect in any candidate; recorded so the OCR fallback's timing relative to the predict fan-out is visible to maintainers, since one candidate's subject-matter inference (landlord-tenant or civil-rights) was wrong for want of the text.
